title: Review-composition contract file map
scope: The authoring-handoff area of commit f9416d9: the composer and producer Skill entrypoints, their authoring references, the normative implementation specification, the static contract test, the installer that makes the canonical Skills discoverable, and the unchanged CLI consumer that exposes install/status. Agent metadata, README, changelog, architecture, CLI protocol, compatibility, decisions, package-smoke, installer tests, protocol tests, and evaluation documents are explicitly outside this map because they expose, restate, package-test, or evaluate the bounded handoff rather than own it. Their local assertions, installer copy/conflict internals, and operation-specific publication remain direct-code topics; this is not a complete changed-file or impact inventory.

presentation.thesis: The composer contract delegates one-Artifact verification to two producer contracts; specification and tests constrain that policy, while the installer and its unchanged CLI consumer make the three Skill entrypoints available to supported hosts.
